newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia late palm olein up on Malaysia gains.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia late palm olein up on Malaysia gains.

text.p: Indonesian palm olein prices were higher in late trading on Monday, buoyed by sharp gains in Malaysia, traders said.

They said olein was quoted at 1,455-60 rupiah/kg in Jakarta, up from 1,450-55 rupiah at the opening, but offers were also heard at 1,465 rupiah. Crude palm oil was done at an equivalent of 1,251 rupiah/kg at a 500-tonne tender in Medan.
"Offer prices are climbing because of the sharp increases in Malaysia," one trader said. "Some sellers are not offering any olein because they expect prices to pick up further tomorrow.
